description: Object key 'caf' + U+0065 (LATIN SMALL LETTER E) + U+0301 (COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT) is a five-code-point NFD form of the visually identical four-code-point NFC 'café'. The canonicalizer MUST NOT Unicode-normalize security-relevant string content per docs/spec-core.md §7.2 (Representation vs. normalization) and docs/canonicalization.md §7 (no normalization beyond the RFC 8785 profile PIC uses). The expected canonical output preserves the NFD byte sequence (UTF-8: 0xCC 0x81 for U+0301). The regression pinned here: an implementation that normalized inputs to NFC before canonicalization would produce 0xC3 0xA9 for U+00E9 instead, yielding a different byte string and a different SHA-256. The NFD key is written in the vector as the ASCII-safe JSON escape '\u0301' so no editor or filesystem filter can silently reconstitute the precomposed form.
